outline: This course provides a fundamental understanding of statistical quality control concept. Subjects for quality implementation will include: Dimensions of quality, 7 tools for quality improvement, quality function deployment (QFD), failure mode and effect analysis (FMEA), Taguchi experimental deign, Kano model of quality, TRIZ, etc, etc.
schedule:
1	Dimensions of quality,
3-4	7 tools for quality improvement,
5	quality function deployment (QFD),
6	failure mode and effect analysis (FMEA),
8-9	Taguchi experimental deign,
10	Kano model of quality,
11	Process capability
12-13	Control chart
14-16	Systematic innovation (TRIZ)
18	Final exam
assessment:
1.	Group report: 40 %
2.	Attendance 30%
3.	(Final exam 30%)
4.	extra score for participation
